name: paragon
description: Paragon – Sales Transaction Management and Approval Web Application

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @paragon/shared" "npm run dev -w @paragon/api" "npm run dev -w @paragon/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @paragon/api && npm run build -w @paragon/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @paragon/api && npm run typecheck -w @paragon/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @paragon/shared && npm run test -w @paragon/api && npm run test -w @paragon/web
